overall settings.description:
Under *Setup* (shortcut key **u**), browse the *Pre-built Scenarios*. Or, restore a previously saved game by clicking *Upload*.

To start from scratch, go to *Scenario Settings* and describe your idea, along with a title. Next, add a few initial items, a location, and a character. More can be set up as the game goes along. Your AI can provide lists to choose from.
overall settings.title: Generic Adventure
